reason: The policy provides only two actions for a pending order: cancel the whole order, or modify items by replacing each item with a different-option variant of the same product (via modify_pending_order_items with matching item_ids/new_item_ids of equal length). There is no policy-supported mechanism to remove/cancel only a subset of items from a pending order while keeping others. The candidate call passes three item_ids with an empty new_item_ids list, which does not replace the items with same-product variants as required ('For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option') and mismatches the tool's positional-matching requirement. This is an attempt at partial-item removal without replacement, which is not an authorized action under the policy, so it must be blocked.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders. Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
